built_from: map/gen_place_ids.py, derived from every tracked site/arda_*.json

compound.why: this id names MORE THAN ONE defined place. It is not a correspondence and is deliberately not resolved: a map that picked one would be choosing which place the reference is, and it is both. The reference stays broken, visibly.

correspondences.why: a complete word-prefix of exactly one defined place
a leading article and separators; 'high pass' names it

note: A third way one place is named twice, after the two SPELLINGS of arda_aliases.json and the two NUMBERING CONVENTIONS of arda_person_ids.json: a short name for a full one, a definite article, or one id naming two places. Every row is DERIVED and records its route. COMPOUND is stated and never resolved -- one id naming two records is not a correspondence, and choosing one of them would be choosing a winner, which the owner's ruling forbids.
